baseline.integrityBoundary: Lockfile SRI recorded, not tarball reattestation. No installation or asset startup.

ours.method: Static concrete factory/dispatcher inspection; no constructor or command invocation

classificationLimits.caveat: Alias spelling census is not distinct independent implementation count. Missing names are not missing equivalent capabilities; no functional result is inferred.

cases.name: alias
cases.script: alias greet='printf alias-ok' && shopt -s expand_aliases && eval greet
cases.intent: Define and expand an alias into an actual command, not merely list its definition.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: builtin
cases.intent: Dispatch the printf builtin through builtin.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: clear
cases.intent: Emit the documented terminal erase/home control sequence; capture raw terminal bytes.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: column
cases.intent: Align unequal-width CSV fields into an exact table.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: compgen
cases.intent: Compute prefix-filtered completion candidates.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: complete
cases.intent: Create and retrieve a named completion specification; no interactive completion claim.
cases.proofLimit: Stored specification only; an interactive completion engine is not exercised.

cases.name: compopt
cases.script: complete -W 'alpha beta' deploy && compopt -o nospace deploy && compopt deploy
cases.intent: Mutate and retrieve options on an existing completion specification.
cases.proofLimit: Stored completion option only, not interactive behavior; complete is a prerequisite.

cases.name: date
cases.intent: Format a fixed epoch in UTC; do not query the wall clock.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: declare
cases.intent: Declare an integer variable and observe arithmetic assignment semantics.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: dirs
cases.intent: Observe a nonempty directory stack after navigation; preserve pushd output separately.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: du
cases.intent: Measure a 2048-byte file using the pinned logical-VFS-size profile.
cases.proofLimit: The baseline reports ceiling(logical bytes/1024), not native allocated blocks. No native disk-allocation parity claim; -b is not a supported pinned baseline option.

cases.name: egrep
cases.intent: Use extended alternation through the actual egrep alias handler.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: exec
cases.script: exec printf '%s\n' exec-ok; target_status=$?; printf 'unexpected-tail\n' > /fixture/after-exec; exit "$target_status"
cases.intent: Dispatch a real command through exec and require subsequent statements not to run. If they do run, preserve the target's own status rather than masking it.
cases.proofLimit: Virtual control-flow replacement only, never host-process replacement.

cases.name: expand
cases.intent: Expand a tab to a fixed four-column stop.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: expr
cases.intent: Evaluate a nonzero arithmetic expression.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: fgrep
cases.intent: Match a literal dot without regex interpretation.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: file
cases.intent: Classify deterministic ASCII text content, not a command label.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: fold
cases.intent: Wrap a ten-character line at four columns.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: getopts
cases.intent: Parse an option argument and observe all three resulting variables.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: hash
cases.script: hash -p /bin/echo echo && hash -t echo && echo hash-ok
cases.intent: Assign and retrieve a command hash mapping, then dispatch the mapped command.
cases.proofLimit: Mapping and invocation do not establish cache performance or native PATH-search equivalence.

cases.name: help
cases.intent: Attempt the intrinsic documentation operation and retain output as a VFS artifact; explicitly excluded from operational-tool success.
cases.proofLimit: User prohibits help/usage as operational proof. This name is attempted but can never earn functional credit from this recipe.

cases.name: history
cases.intent: Clear a deliberately seeded history list and verify retrieval is empty.
cases.proofLimit: Seeded public environment storage, not proof that interactive commands are automatically recorded.

cases.name: hostname
cases.intent: Read the sandbox's virtual hostname, not the host machine identity.
cases.proofLimit: Pinned baseline returns a fixed virtual identity; no configurable/network hostname claim.

cases.name: html-to-markdown
cases.intent: Convert structured HTML heading and emphasis into Markdown.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: let
cases.intent: Mutate an arithmetic variable and observe its value.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: mapfile
cases.intent: Read two VFS lines into an indexed array without trailing delimiters.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: nl
cases.intent: Number every line, including an empty line.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: popd
cases.intent: Return from a previously pushed directory; redirected target output remains captured in VFS.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: printenv
cases.intent: Retrieve a deliberately supplied environment variable.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: pushd
cases.intent: Change the current directory through stack navigation.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: readarray
cases.intent: Invoke the readarray name to populate and read a two-element array.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: rev
cases.intent: Reverse characters independently on each line.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: seq
cases.intent: Generate an inclusive stepped numeric sequence.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: shopt
cases.intent: Enable dotglob and verify that glob expansion changes.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: sleep
cases.intent: Await a nonzero short timer without an injected sleep shim.
cases.proofLimit: A broad lower-bound sanity check only; elapsed time is retained raw and is not a performance comparison.

cases.name: split
cases.intent: Split a three-line file into exact two-line/one-line VFS outputs.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: sqlite3
cases.script: sqlite3 /fixture/data.db 'CREATE TABLE items(name TEXT, value INTEGER); INSERT INTO items VALUES ("alpha", 2), ("beta", 3); SELECT sum(value) FROM items;'
targetArgv: CREATE TABLE items(name TEXT, value INTEGER); INSERT INTO items VALUES ("alpha", 2), ("beta", 3); SELECT sum(value) FROM items;
cases.intent: Create a real virtual SQLite database, insert rows, and aggregate them.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: strings
cases.intent: Extract printable spans from binary VFS bytes.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: tac
cases.intent: Reverse complete line order.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: time
cases.intent: Force the time registry wrapper, execute a child, and emit a deterministic format string rather than accidentally measuring the shell keyword.
cases.proofLimit: Custom-format dispatch control, not timer accuracy or performance evidence.

cases.name: timeout
cases.intent: Run a successful child inside a deadline; this is not timeout-expiry/cancellation proof.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: tree
cases.intent: Traverse a deterministic nested VFS tree using the supported default interface.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: typeset
cases.intent: Exercise integer declaration and arithmetic assignment via the typeset spelling.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: unalias
cases.script: alias echo='printf wrong' && unalias echo && eval 'echo restored'
cases.intent: Remove an alias and verify normal dispatch is restored.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: unexpand
cases.intent: Compress spaces to a fixed tab stop.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: wait
cases.intent: Launch a virtual background write, wait, then inspect the resulting file outside the script.
cases.proofLimit: Pinned source says wait is a no-op and background execution is unsupported. Even matching output cannot establish asynchronous job-join semantics; never functional-credit a no-op.

cases.name: which
cases.intent: Resolve a callable command's virtual path; separate from builtin type labels.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: whoami
cases.intent: Read the sandbox's virtual user identity.
cases.proofLimit: Pinned baseline's fixed virtual user is not host-user or permission enforcement evidence.

cases.name: xan
cases.intent: Project one named column from a CSV table.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: yq
cases.intent: Parse YAML and extract a nested scalar as JSON.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: js-exec
cases.intent: Execute guest JavaScript arithmetic in the shipped QuickJS worker, not host Node.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: node
cases.intent: Attempt actual JavaScript execution through node and preserve the pinned diagnostic-stub response.
cases.proofLimit: No native Node fallback or js-exec substitution. A diagnostic response is baseline-stub, not a working runtime.

cases.name: python
cases.intent: Run guest Python arithmetic and write exact bytes through the shipped CPython VFS bridge.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: python3
cases.intent: Run guest Python arithmetic and write exact bytes through the shipped CPython VFS bridge.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.intent: Exercise the now-overlapping source handler, preserving its historical inventory row.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: source
cases.intent: Exercise the now-overlapping source handler, preserving its historical inventory row.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: eval
cases.intent: Exercise now-overlapping eval state mutation without changing historical results.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: printf
cases.intent: Check shell invocation, terminal capture and known shared behavior.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: printf
cases.intent: Separate exact internal VFS bytes from the public terminal-byte API.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.

cases.name: curl
cases.intent: Use each documented optional network plugin to download fixed loopback-only response bytes.
cases.proofLimit: One bounded positive recipe, not complete command or option coverage.
